title: "Future State Map"

## Design a better flow

A Future State Map turns evidence from the Current State Map into a practical design for improved flow. Preserve the current-state files as a baseline, then remove unnecessary steps, reduce queues and rework, introduce pull where demand should trigger work, and mark proposed improvements with Kaizen bursts.

Set measurable targets rather than drawing an idealized process. Compare target cycle time, lead time, and defect or error measures with the latest timestamped observation for each process component.

## Inputs and outputs

Bring the `.drawio` source and metadata `.csv` exported by the [Current State workspace](./current-primary.qmd). The Future State workspace produces:

- an updated diagram in `.drawio`, editable `.drawio.svg`, and `.png` formats;
- an append-only, timestamped target metadata log; and
- live cycle-time, lead-time, and defect/error reduction summaries.
